name: decision-cards
description: Asks proposed ADRs in the native question dialog and records the answer, checks questions and replies, and generates the base prompt from a shared vault of terms and decisions

adrDir.title: Decisions folder
adrDir.description: Folder of ADR notes: absolute for a shared vault, or relative to the project

termsDir.title: Terms folder
termsDir.description: Folder of term notes: absolute for a shared vault, or relative to the project

indexFile.title: Index note
indexFile.description: Where the generated map of content is written; empty to skip

docsFile.title: Docs note
docsFile.description: Where the generated Docs (rules and terms as one document) is written; empty to skip

baseFile.title: Base prompt
baseFile.description: Where the generated base prompt (the rules, reply and question shapes, and terms every agent follows) is written; empty to skip

projectVault.title: Project vault folder
projectVault.description: A folder inside each project whose Decisions and Terms are layered over the shared vault, the project's note winning
